title_as_printed: Apparent Molar Volumes, Fit Deviations, Water Densities, and Density Differences for CaCl2(aq)

footnotes_as_printed.a: From the equation of state of Haar, Gallagher, and Kell, Ref. 15.

property_description: value = measured density difference rho - rho0 between the CaCl2 solution and pure water at the same t and p (printed 10^3 d_rho, scale 0.001, g/cm3); V_phi (derived by the authors, Eq. 1), rho0 (Haar-Gallagher-Kell, literature) and dV_phi (fit deviation) are in extra_unmapped
pressure_note: not stated how defined; printed per row in bars (cell pressure of the high-pressure vibrating-tube densimeter, nominally near 70 and 400 bar); the pressure column varies between rows of one nominal-pressure block by up to 4 bar

value.what: measured density difference rho - rho0 between the CaCl2 solution and pure water at the same t and p

extra_unmapped: V_phi cm3-mol^-1 (apparent molar volume, calculated by the authors from the density difference, Eq. 1)
rho0 g-cm^-3 (water density from the Haar, Gallagher and Kell equation of state, literature, not measured)
dV_phi (fit deviation from the authors' model; not data)
notes: Rows are printed in blocks (nominal 70 bar and nominal 400 bar at each of 25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 C, separated by blank lines) with no label rows; the CSV keeps the printed order. Replicate m values within a block are real repeat runs (kept).
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: The measured datum is the density difference (p.899: V_phi 'obtained from density differences (delta rho) between the solution of interest and water'); V_phi is derived by the authors. Printed oddities noted in paper.json are kept as printed.
